title: Power Stack Watchlist
method: Action-oriented queue combining business quality, plausible upside, downside/funding risk, valuation, technical location, current theme significance and usefulness beside the existing portfolio. Structural research score and buy-now score are deliberately separate: a strong long-term thesis can rank lower today when real yields, crowding, price location or portfolio overlap are hostile.
marketRegime: Bond/term-premium stress and refined-product inflation remain the immediate gate. Gold/monetary hedges are structurally strengthening but tactically fragile into the September Fed decision; crypto is constructive medium term but more liquidity-sensitive. Corporate breakups are producing several genuine pure-play opportunities, led by FLEX's planned Cloud & Power spin, SOLS and LHX. Critical-mineral sovereignty is phasing in, led by real producers rather than pre-revenue explorers.

buckets.label: Buy / Accumulate
buckets.description: Price, business quality and current theme setup are aligned enough for staged entry.

buckets.label: Selective / Retest
buckets.description: Good business/theme, but current price, tactical macro risk or portfolio overlap requires a better level or confirmation.

buckets.label: Wait / Confirm
buckets.description: Interesting exposure, but current risk/reward or cyclical timing is not strong enough to force.

buckets.label: Avoid / High Risk
buckets.description: Theme may be attractive, but financing, valuation, dilution or execution risk currently dominates.

candidates.name: CF Industries
candidates.entry: $123–127 preferred; small starter only if ~$128–130 holds
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$118 or sharp collapse in nitrogen margins / US gas advantage
candidates.thesis: Best current commodity-agriculture expression. Nitrogen is harder to defer than most farm inputs, North American gas economics remain advantaged, and cash flow/buybacks reduce reliance on multiple expansion.

candidates.name: Corteva
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$78 or weakening seed pricing / separation economics
candidates.thesis: Highest-quality agriculture compounder plus a near-term value-unlock catalyst. Sep 15 Investor Day and targeted Oct 1 Vylor separation are the next tests.

candidates.name: SPDR Gold MiniShares
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$79.5 or decisive real-yield/USD breakout
candidates.thesis: Best core gold implementation. Fiscal/geopolitical/debasement structure is strong, but September Fed risk argues for staged accumulation rather than chasing August's move.

candidates.name: Agnico Eagle Mines
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$185 or material AISC/production deterioration
candidates.thesis: Highest-quality gold miner in the sleeve. Strong FCF and net cash make it more resilient than most miners, but it remains an equity in a tactically choppy market.

candidates.name: Bunge Global
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$106 or Viterra integration / crush-margin deterioration
candidates.thesis: Diversified exposure to crop-flow volatility, crushing/refining and global food logistics. One of the best portfolio-complement ideas because its return driver differs from oil and AI-power.

candidates.name: Cameco
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$92 or deterioration in contracting / mine / Westinghouse evidence
candidates.thesis: Prefer operating uranium/fuel scarcity and Westinghouse exposure over pre-revenue reactor hype. A potential Westinghouse IPO adds another future value-unlock catalyst.

candidates.name: Flex
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$98 or CPI growth/backlog/standalone economics deteriorate
candidates.thesis: The most Power-Stack-native spin-off catalyst found: CPI Q1 revenue +35%, 9.7% margin, 65–75% FY27 growth guide and 80%+ FY28 outlook. Strong setup, but overlaps existing grid/data-centre exposure.

candidates.name: Kinross Gold
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$26 or AISC/production deterioration
candidates.thesis: More upside torque and valuation asymmetry than AEM, with greater drawdown risk. Prefer on pullbacks while the structural gold thesis remains intact.

candidates.name: Cheniere Energy
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$268 or rapid normalization of global LNG scarcity/spreads
candidates.thesis: US LNG infrastructure is a strategic supply-diversification asset, but the stock is near resistance and overlaps broader energy exposure.

candidates.name: Wheaton Precious Metals
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$135 or precious-metal thesis breaks
candidates.thesis: Cleaner precious-metal equity when oil/labour/mining costs rise because streaming avoids much direct mine-cost inflation.

candidates.name: Quanta Services
candidates.invalidation: Sustained break below ~$560 with backlog/order deterioration
candidates.thesis: Record backlog/RPO and FCF keep PWR among the highest-quality AI-power bottlenecks. Higher yields and existing portfolio overlap require entry discipline.

candidates.name: Solstice Advanced Materials
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$54 or raised guidance/UF6 thesis deteriorates
candidates.thesis: Excellent post-spin pure play: sole US UF6 supplier, raised guidance, 25%+ EBITDA margin and a $500m buyback after abandoning the expensive Element deal. Do not chase the post-cancellation gap.

candidates.name: Eaton
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$380 or material electrical-order/backlog deterioration
candidates.thesis: Electrical orders/backlog remain extraordinary, but the bond regime is a genuine multiple headwind.

candidates.name: L3Harris Technologies
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$250 or Missile Solutions IPO/backlog thesis deteriorates
candidates.thesis: Record $42bn backlog and strong FCF support the parent while the planned Missile Solutions IPO offers a rare pure-play solid-rocket-motor value-unlock catalyst.

candidates.name: Nutrien
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$69 or clear fertilizer demand destruction / potash deterioration
candidates.thesis: Diversified fertilizer exposure; potash is more deferrable than nitrogen, keeping NTR below CF.

candidates.name: Qnity Electronics
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$105 or organic/EBITDA growth rolls over
candidates.thesis: Q2 sales +22%, adjusted earnings +53% and EBITDA +24% make Qnity a real profitable AI-materials pure play, though still valuation-sensitive.

candidates.name: Coinbase Global
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$155 or activity/USDC/subscription momentum deteriorates
candidates.thesis: Best crypto-equity fundamentals, but the August rebound and hostile real-yield regime argue against chasing.

candidates.name: SLB
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$52 or Kelvion integration / leverage economics deteriorate
candidates.thesis: Kelvion creates a measurable oil-services + AI-cooling crossover; acquisition/integration risk prevents a higher rank.

candidates.name: Valmont Industries
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$440 or weakening infrastructure/agriculture orders
candidates.thesis: Useful grid + irrigation crossover; agriculture capex is deferrable, so this remains a second-stage farm-income/weather trade.

candidates.name: Salesforce
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$225 or AI monetisation/cRPO/FCF momentum fades
candidates.thesis: Strong proof that incumbent software can monetize AI, but the post-earnings gap should not be chased.

candidates.name: VanEck Gold Miners ETF
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$88 or broad miner margins deteriorate
candidates.thesis: Diversified gold-equity torque, but much more equity-sensitive than GLDM.

candidates.name: CrowdStrike
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$200 or ARR/net-new-ARR/FCF momentum deteriorates
candidates.thesis: Mission-critical security and strong ARR fit the selective software rotation, but valuation/price location are demanding.

candidates.name: Bitcoin
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$68k with ETF/liquidity deterioration
candidates.thesis: Medium-term structure is constructive, but real-yield/Fed tightening risk keeps the immediate score below gold.

candidates.name: MP Materials
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$45 or magnet/production/government-support thesis deteriorates
candidates.thesis: Best practical US rare-earth sovereignty exposure with real production and magnet economics; policy dependence, dilution and commodity volatility keep it below the highest-quality scarcity names.

candidates.name: Freeport-McMoRan
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$64 or structural copper-demand/supply thesis break
candidates.thesis: Structural copper thesis remains good; current tariff/inventory distortions and proximity to resistance make chase risk poor.

candidates.name: Honeywell Aerospace
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$140 or another material guidance cut
candidates.thesis: Reasonable valuation and strong backlog, but the first standalone quarter cut organic-growth and EBIT guidance. Require proof that the reset is complete.

candidates.name: Symbotic
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$35 or deployment/revenue/EBITDA momentum rolls over
candidates.thesis: Commercial automation remains the most underwritable robotics wave; this is company-specific rather than a top macro theme today.

candidates.name: AGCO Corporation
candidates.entry: No aggressive entry until crop/farm margins improve
candidates.invalidation: Further equipment-demand cuts or persistent fertilizer/fuel squeeze
candidates.thesis: Potential operating leverage if crop prices restore farm income; do not front-run machinery recovery aggressively.

candidates.name: Strategy
candidates.invalidation: <$100 or mNAV/financing stress accelerates
candidates.thesis: Explosive potential in a liquidity boom, but dilution, preferred obligations and mNAV reflexivity make it materially worse risk-adjusted than BTC/COIN now.

candidates.name: VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF
candidates.confirmation: Broad junior-miner breakout with financing conditions improving
candidates.invalidation: Gold loses support or junior financing/dilution worsens
candidates.thesis: Convex gold beta, but the current bond/credit regime is poor for weaker-balance-sheet juniors.

candidates.name: NuScale Power
candidates.entry: No entry until commercial/financing evidence improves
candidates.invalidation: Continued financing/dilution weakness
candidates.thesis: Nuclear remains strategically strong, but higher yields make venture-style reactor equities less attractive than operating fuel/components and cash-generating infrastructure.
